name: Boneflayer

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

languages: understands Common but can't speak it

traits.name: Flyby
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
traits.text: The boneflayer provokes no Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Thunderous Ward
traits.summary: Hearing a drum or gong, or taking Thunder damage, gives it Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.
traits.text: When the boneflayer hears a drum or a gong, or takes Thunder damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: One Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.summary: +7, 2d8+4 Slashing, and the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
actions.text: A filthy beak cleaves flesh: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Talons
actions.summary: +7, 2d6+4 Piercing; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled in both talons (escape DC 14) and Restrained while held.
actions.text: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from both talons, and is Restrained for as long as it is Grappled.

bonus_actions.name: Swoop
bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. With a creature in its talons, flies up to half its Fly Speed without Opportunity Attacks and drops it.
bonus_actions.text: If the boneflayer has a creature Grappled, it flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and then lets that creature fall.

summary: A vulture-like fey-pact monster that snatches prey in its talons, carries it up and drops it; loud thunderous noise throws it off.
